title: SKLZ Hitting Stick Batting Swing Trainer (Target Swing Trainer, Baseball)
writeup: The SKLZ Hitting Stick (sold by SKLZ as the Target Swing Trainer for baseball, model 0713) is $24.99 new on Woot Sport, with a three-per-customer limit. SKLZ's own store charges $44.99 for the same trainer and Walmart lists it at $60.75, so this is about 44 percent less. A coach holds the stick to set a target at any height, which makes it handy for drilling pitch locations in the backyard.
